newsitem.title: UK: Shield gets confirmation of AFT potential.
newsitem.headline: Shield gets confirmation of AFT potential.

text.p: Shield Diagnostics Plc said on Friday that a trial co-ordinator had confirmed that initial analysis of its Associated Factor 12 (AFT) product in an ongoing test was in line with earlier results.
Preliminary results supported the use of AFT as a risk predictor for cardiovascular disease.

"I can confirm that an initial analysis of the NPHS II study has been carried out and that the AFT results for the prospective data appear to support the cross-sectional results already accepted for publication," said Doctor Miller of the Medical Research Council said in a letter.
Shares in the company rose on the news to stand 48p higher at 464-1/2p by 1314 GMT.
